what: Native's dipole beside the peaks: Native's stored record placed on the tape, each line at the tick it could first be known. Native's record is Native's; nothing of it is worked out again here
laid_out_and_approved: markets-data STEP2_PLAN.md, piece D (Greg, 2026-11-16; his go 2026-11-17)
native_record_starts: 8 pm Eastern (00:00 UTC): the first two hours of the trade day are not in Native's stored record; the counts beside the rows are empty until then
to_revisit: Native's record is built on its own fixed windows (a 20-second roll, a level set from 85 in 100 seconds, 60-second horizons)

columns.what: Native's dipoles of polarity +1 (net buying) that are known and not closed once this tick is done. Empty before Native's record starts on this trade day.
The same for dipoles whose polarity Native's record does not give.
How many lines about a dipole or a peak became known at this tick (they are in the facts file).

fact_columns.what: The tick at which this line became known: its position on the tape. A label only.
When that tick was received.
Recognized or closed (a line of Native's record placed on the tape), or peak known.
Native's candidate number. A label only. On peak known: the dipole most lately recognized that is not closed; empty when there is none.
Native's polarity for the dipole: +1 or -1, the sign of the signed flow.
Native's magnitude for the dipole.
Native's time for the dipole's birth (the start of its second).
Native's time for its recognition (the start of its second).
The received time at which Native wrote this line. On peak known: empty.
Native's detection lag, in seconds.
Native's orientation, in its own words.
Native's recognition outcome, in its own words.
On closed: Native's terminal phase, in its own words.
On closed: Native's stage count.
From Native's birth time to this tick.
On closed and on peak known: from the tick the dipole's recognized line was placed to this tick.
Dipoles of polarity +1 known and not closed once this tick is done.
The same for polarity -1.
The same for dipoles whose polarity the record does not give.
On peak known: the tick of the peak's high. A label only.
On peak known: buy or sell.
The buy peak most lately known at this tick: the tick of its high. A label only. Empty when no buy peak has become known yet in the trade day.
From that high to this tick.
Where that peak's story stands once this tick is done: open, past zero, or ended.
The sell peak most lately known at this tick: the tick of its high. A label only. Empty when no sell peak has become known yet in the trade day.
From that high to this tick.
Where that peak's story stands once this tick is done: open, past zero, or ended.
The rise under way at this tick, if the flow has a high that has not come off yet: buy or sell. Empty when there is none.
The tick of that rise's high so far. A label only. It is not a peak yet.
From that high so far to this tick.

playback.cut_at: one tick before the middle recognized line

checks.method: the tick of every line of Native's record found again along the whole column of received times; the counts added up along the sorted lines; the peaks in play from the stored outputs of pieces 1 and 2 as whole tables

empty_cells: stored as empty (null): never 0, never blank text
